name: unauthorized-admin-user
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: creates an intern account and grants it membership in the Ubuntu sudo administrator group.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if ! id intern >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd -m -s /bin/bash intern; fi
if getent group sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    usermod -a -G sudo intern
elif getent group wheel >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    usermod -a -G wheel intern
else
    groupadd sudo
    usermod -a -G sudo intern
fi
